updates.title: Live email sign-in scripts ship with each deploy

sections.heading: Auth
fixes: Vercel deploys no longer reuse a stale local public folder that could omit new site scripts.

updates.title: Email me a link works on the live site again

sections.heading: Auth
fixes: Log in, sign up, and the email verify page load again after a missing auth helper script broke them on Vercel.

updates.title: Email sign-in returns to the device that asked

sections.heading: Auth
added: Opening the email link signs in the device that requested it, even when the link is opened on another device.

updates.title: Account, payout, and a four-step create wizard

sections.heading: Wizard
added: Create a trade asks for the name and amount, then category and delivery with an optional description, then your side and name, then the policies.
The terms summary field is no longer part of creating a trade.

sections.heading: Auth
added: Starting a trade requires an email account so the creator can be paid.

sections.heading: Payments
added: Sellers add a Stripe payout account before a trade can be created or paid. Stripe sends the card authorization there. TradeSafe does not hold the money.

sections.heading: Room
added: A seller without a payout account sees Add payout account as the next step.

updates.title: A clear next step and real card payments

sections.heading: Room
added: The room shows one next step, such as accept, pay, or confirm, and a paused trade no longer offers Open a dispute again.

sections.heading: Payments
added: Pay opens a Stripe card authorization. TradeSafe does not hold the money, and new trades are not demo simulations.

sections.heading: Wizard
added: Create a trade is one screen for the title, amount, role, and name, with extra details in a dropdown and a large create button.

sections.heading: Room
added: The room shows the amount, whose turn it is, and large next-step buttons. People are smaller with an anonymous picture, and report a concern is a dropdown.

sections.heading: Design
added: Dropdowns, role choices, and form buttons share the same field and button styles.

updates.title: Let the Vercel production build finish

sections.heading: Design
fixes: The Vercel build keeps existing public files while copying the site, so production deploys no longer fail before the live site updates.

updates.title: Publish the live Vercel site with each update

sections.heading: Design
fixes: The live site at tradesafe-alpha.vercel.app is deployed with each update, and pages are not cached for an hour after a release.

sections.heading: Wizard
added: The create-trade form is a centered card. Continue moves on when the title and amount are filled, and names whichever of those is empty. Terms, the acknowledgement, display name, and policies are named on their own steps.

sections.heading: Design
added: The home icon is gone. Menu sits on the left and Log in sits on the right.
fixes: Styles and scripts are not cached for an hour, so a refresh shows the latest page.

sections.heading: Auth
added: Log in and sign up use an email link only. There is no password.

sections.heading: API
added: GET /api/trades/:id/confidence returns a minimized Trade Confidence payload only for registered, email-verified joined participants.

sections.heading: Room
added: A collapsible Trade Confidence card loads beside participants for eligible accounts, with factual signals and an honest non-guarantee footer.

sections.heading: Security
added: Trade Confidence omits guest access, unverified viewers, non-participants, raw device/IP data, and counterparty session-familiarity badges; completed-trade counts exclude demo and non-completed statuses.
The privacy policy explains what Trade Confidence may show and that it is not a trust score, identity check, or guarantee.

sections.heading: Auth
added: Registered sessions send a Bearer token from the shared API client so email-verified account checks work alongside guest cookies.

sections.heading: API
added: Pushing a version bump to GitHub publishes a GitHub Release from brain/releases.json (workflow plus npm run release:github) so notes appear under the repo Releases tab.

updates.title: Security consent, fraud logging, and admin review

sections.heading: Security
added: Create and join require server-recorded acceptance of Terms, Privacy, Dispute, Security, and Device Notice drafts (bundle 2026-10-22-s), with a separate optional device-recognition checkbox.

A centralized security-event log records create/join, invite failures, unauthorized trade access, consent, reports, and payment webhooks using hashed IP and session refs — not invasive fingerprinting.
Participants can submit security reports from the trade room; reporters see status only, never another party’s IP, device data, or risk score.
Authorized admins get a Security Management dashboard with incident timelines, audited investigation updates, and masked IP by default.

sections.heading: Auth
added: Optional first-party device cookies are issued only after optional consent; declining does not bypass guest sessions, authorization, invite rate limits, or payment integrity checks.

sections.heading: Payments
added: Payment status changes only through verified provider/webhook or demo-server paths; client set_payment_status actions are rejected.

sections.heading: API
added: New consent, report, admin security, and payment webhook routes enforce consent and admin checks on the server with RLS deny-all on security tables for clients.

updates.title: Hooxie site chrome and legal layout

sections.heading: Design
added: Marketing and app pages use Hooxie’s cream site.css, Manrope font files, floating home button, and full-screen Menu overlay.

sections.heading: Landing
added: The homepage hero matches Hooxie’s split CTA pattern with Create a trade and Learn more.

sections.heading: Security
added: Legal policies are presented in Hooxie-style Legal tabs for Terms, Privacy, and Disputes.

updates.title: Guest-first access with required policy acceptance

sections.heading: Auth
added: Ordinary create, join, and room flows no longer require login or registration; secure guest session cookies identify participants.
fixes: Login and signup links were removed from the primary navigation and homepage CTAs.

sections.heading: Wizard
added: Create trade requires an unchecked policy checkbox and display name; the server records policy versions before creating the trade.

sections.heading: Join
added: Invite links show a public summary, then require display name and platform policy acceptance before granting room access.

sections.heading: Security
added: Append-only ts_policy_acceptances and ts_guest_sessions tables; clients cannot forge policy versions or acceptance timestamps.

updates.title: Live Vercel deploy linked from the repo

sections.heading: Landing
added: README and the GitHub repo point to the production site at https://tradesafe-alpha.vercel.app.

sections.heading: API
added: Vercel serves site/ as static public/ and runs /api/* through a serverless catch-all that reuses server.mjs handlers.

sections.heading: Auth

updates.title: Vanilla HTML site with Hooxie design

fixes: App pages no longer render the old near-black SaaS component look.

sections.heading: Landing
added: site/index.html is a cream marketing page with Create, Track, Complete, FAQ, and honest non-escrow copy.

sections.heading: Dashboard
added: site/dashboard.html lists joined trades from the API with clear status and demo tags.

sections.heading: Wizard
added: site/create.html walks through details, role, terms, and review, then shows a one-time invite link.

sections.heading: Room
added: site/room.html shows dual progress bars with labels, payment and fulfillment cards, timeline, chat, and role actions.

sections.heading: Join
added: site/join.html and /join/:token accept hashed invitation links in the browser.

added: server.mjs serves the static site and JSON routes for trades, invites, messages, and profile using the Supabase service role on the server only.

sections.heading: Auth

updates.title: Private live trade rooms on the web

sections.heading: Landing
added: The home page explains Create, Track, and Complete with honest copy that TradeSafe is not escrow or insurance.

sections.heading: API
added: Server routes enforce a transaction state machine, participant permissions, rate limits, and Supabase-backed persistence with realtime updates.

sections.heading: Security
added: Privileged payment states only move from provider or demo-server sources, with RLS on ts_ tables and security headers on responses.
